rule: A redelivered Paddle transaction.completed event adds the credits once
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO "ProcessedWebhookEvent"(id) VALUES ('evt_1') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id) UPDATE "Billing" SET credits=credits+500 WHERE "organizationId"='org_1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)
